articles.summary: ( NASDAQ: ALGT ) has scheduled its third quarter 2026 financial results conference call for Wednesday, November 4 at 4:30 p.m. EST. A live broadcast of the conference call will be available through the company's Investor Relations website homepage at http://ir.allegiantair.com . The webcast will also be archived on the "Events Presentations" section of the site. About Allegiant – Together We Fly™ Las Vegas-based Allegiant is an integrated travel company with an airline at its heart, focused on connecting customers with the people, places and experiences that matter most. Through Allegiant Air and Sun Country Airlines, the company serves approximately 22 million annual customers across scheduled passenger, charter and cargo operations. Together, the airlines operate more than 650 routes serving nearly 175 cities throughout the United States and select international destinations. articles.summary: (NASDAQ: ALGT) announced today that it has accepted the resignation of Jude Bricker from his position on the company's board of directors, effective immediately, as he has shared plans to pursue other professional opportunities within the industry. Bricker joined Allegiant's board upon the closing of the company's acquisition of Sun Country Airlines in May 2026. He previously served as CEO of Sun Country Airlines from 2017 through May 2026. "It has been an honor to work with the dedicated people of this outstanding organization and serve on the board of directors," said Bricker. "With Allegiant and Sun Country's integration well under way, the solid management team is well positioned to lead the combined airline into its next successful chapter." "On behalf of the entire board, I would like to thank Jude for his service and contributions to Allegiant and Sun Country," said Maurice J. Gallagher, chairman of Allegiant's board of directors.
